thread:
mira: quick notefound a confusing example in the Console observability docs. the KV cache snippet uses `cacheTTL: 0` to indicate 'no caching' but when i applied it on a staging cluster it still had cache hits for ~20s. anyone else hit this?

jon: yes, we've seen this after the proto change. numeric 0 started getting omitted during serialization so the runtime falls back to its default TTL. docs should show the nullable form instead.

mira: snippet lives in docs/console/observability/kvcache-quickstart.md around the "Disable example" section. current excerpt:
```yaml
kvCache:
  enabled: true
  cacheTTL: 0  # disable caching in example
```

samir: simplest fix: change to `cacheTTL: null` and add a short explanatory note about runtime versions. also add an HTML id above the snippet so the TOC anchor remains stable (linkcheck sometimes breaks on auto-generated ids).

mira: can someone take the PR? i can file the issue and paste the repro logs.

jon: i'll pick it up. plan: update snippet to null, add migration blurb in docs/migrations/runtime-nullability.md, add a tiny curl example showing the API payload (so users can see \"cacheTTL\": null in JSON), and link to a runtime issue for adding an integration smoke test.

ci-bot: link-check queued.

jon: branch `docs/kvcache-nullify` opened. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4999 - description: "Console: clarify KV cache disablement (nullable TTL) + migration note"

docs-bot: automated linter flagged non-unique snippet id for the dashboard examples.

jon: fixed the snippet id by adding `<!-- id: kvcache-disable-example -->` and updated the TOC anchor to match. also used snake_case `legacy_zero_ttl` in the migration example to match other runtime flags.

ci-bot: preview build created: https://preview.docs.redwood-inference.com/pr/4999 - checks: linter  OK, link-check pending.

docs-bot: link-check: passed.

mira: LGTM, small nit: in the migration note can we mention which runtime releases changed behavior (v2.4 -> v2.5)? that helps users pin appropriately.

jon: added a sentence: "Note: runtimes before v2.5 treated numeric 0 as explicit disable; starting v2.5 null is required." Pushed.

samir: also requested we add a tiny docs-linter rule in a follow-up that warns when examples use `cacheTTL: 0` so we don't regress. filed issue in docs repo.

jon: merged PR 4999 and opened backport #5002 for the 2.x branch. linked runtime issue: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/issues/1977 (smoke test for KV disablement).

mira: thanks everyone. closing thread after backport merges. :white_check_mark:
